interpretation: Periodic deformed-G midsurface family with fixed triangle connectivity and fixed end rims; not a strict minimal-surface or all-harmonic-weight claim
derivative_rule: Unique closest-point envelope derivative -n dot sum(barycentric_i*vertex_velocity_i); no FD in AD rule
differentiability_scope: Piecewise smooth closest-triangle distance; actual independent queries at both FD levels. Report face changes and nonsmooth-query evidence.
end_geometry: T_a fixes z0/1 and periodic seams. Contact points/Q2 interpolation/assignments stay identical by construction; cap occupancy and area are differentiated.
